description: The last seven days of the channel's schedule in one call, for an agent, paid per call, with no account. Filter by title or category across collected days and get calendar events with exact UTC timestamps, without stitching daily files or writing an .ics exporter. Only collected dates are returned. This is schedule metadata, not a video archive, a broadcast license, or a guarantee that the channel will play.
